create_stopwatch_instance: create a Stopwatch instance to track elapsed time between named events in milliseconds
time_stopwatch_key: call the time method on a Stopwatch with a key to record elapsed milliseconds since last call
summary_stopwatch: call the summary method on a Stopwatch to print per-key mean time and percentage breakdown then reset
reset_stopwatch: call the reset method on a Stopwatch to clear all recorded times and restart the clock
millis_interval_datetime: call millis_interval with two datetime instances to compute the elapsed time in milliseconds
